request_summary: Implement inherited tier routing, resumable availability failover and safe bounded advisory diagnosis.

complexity_assessment.rationale: Routing, persisted recovery, provider contracts and advisory permissions cross independent runtime boundaries.
signals: Global configuration and task recovery interact.
Security-sensitive assistant launch and token budgets need explicit tests.

internal_study.rationale: Read the request, runner, configuration, controllers, CLI, validators and their focused tests.
internal_study.plan_finding: Code inspection confirms quota events do not alter the provider candidate set.

material_questions.question: Does quota fallback work without technical escalation?
material_questions.resolution: The current wait path repeats the same provider; a separate bounded availability state is required.
material_questions.planning_impact: Keep availability outside functional failure counters and retain the logical rung.

material_questions.question: Can an advisory role safely reuse the worker profile?
material_questions.resolution: No. Coding profiles permit writes and sandbox defaults are not read-only.
material_questions.planning_impact: Use an independent fail-closed assistant profile, opt-in evidence and bounded budgets.

internal_sources.finding: Provider selection uses functional failures while availability failures only retry or abort.
internal_sources.planning_impact: Add a separate durable availability path with equivalent-rung fallback.

internal_sources.finding: Plan creation writes a full defaults snapshot and quota failures preserve semantic counters.
internal_sources.planning_impact: Preserve legacy snapshots; make new plans explicit overlays.

internal_sources.finding: The unmodified entrypoint exceeds its existing fixed character budget.
internal_sources.planning_impact: Improve instruction concision during final review without raising ceilings.

external_research.rationale: The user explicitly requested wide research; current CLI security and coordination costs change architecture.

sources.title: Anthropic multi-agent research system
sources.finding: Parallel research benefits from bounded specialists, but the reported multi-agent system used roughly 15 times chat tokens. This is workload-specific, not a universal saving.
sources.planning_impact: Gate advice; keep one implementation owner; never promise measured savings.
sources.why_authoritative: Primary documentation or original research by the system authors.

sources.title: Building effective agents
sources.finding: Simple routing and orchestrator-worker workflows are preferable to unnecessary autonomous coordination. Evaluation needs explicit success criteria.
sources.planning_impact: Retain deterministic validators and fail-class authority.
sources.why_authoritative: Primary documentation or original research by the system authors.

sources.title: Effective context engineering
sources.finding: Context is a finite resource; task-scoped retrieval and compact handoffs reduce irrelevant context.
sources.planning_impact: Pass bounded failure evidence, not full logs, plans or conversations.
sources.why_authoritative: Primary documentation or original research by the system authors.

sources.title: Agents SDK multi-agent orchestration
sources.finding: Code-driven orchestration offers explicit control; manager-tool and handoff patterns have different ownership semantics.
sources.planning_impact: Use advisory tools, not ownership transfer, for diagnosis.
sources.why_authoritative: Primary documentation or original research by the system authors.

sources.title: Towards a Science of Scaling Agent Systems
sources.finding: Controlled configurations show coordination benefits depend on task structure; sequential tasks can suffer overhead and error amplification.
sources.planning_impact: Do not introduce mandatory debate, voting or extra model calls.
sources.why_authoritative: Primary documentation or original research by the system authors.

sources.title: Scaling LLM-Driven Multi-Agent Systems
sources.finding: Architecture experiments favor selective feedback and summary-based communication; effectiveness depends on task and model capability.
sources.planning_impact: Use bounded opt-in assistance and explicit stopping conditions.
sources.why_authoritative: Primary documentation or original research by the system authors.

sources.title: Multi-Agent Coordination Adaptation
sources.finding: Budget-conditioned coordination can suppress redundant interactions in its experimental setting.
sources.planning_impact: Enforce call, evidence, time and repetition budgets; benchmark total cost per validated outcome.
sources.why_authoritative: Primary documentation or original research by the system authors.

sources.title: Claude CLI reference
sources.finding: tools empty disables built-ins but not MCP; restricted mode and settings controls matter. auth status exits zero when logged in.
sources.planning_impact: Disable all model tools and customizations; distinguish installed from authenticated.
sources.why_authoritative: Primary documentation or original research by the system authors.

sources.title: Codex CLI reference
sources.finding: codex login status checks credential presence without a generation request. Read-only is distinct from workspace-write.
sources.planning_impact: Use a bounded status probe; do not infer authentication from executable presence.
sources.why_authoritative: Primary documentation or original research by the system authors.

sources.title: Antigravity sandbox
sources.finding: The sandbox permits writes in its workspace. Sandbox enabled alone is not a read-only guarantee.
sources.planning_impact: Fail closed without a verified no-write execution boundary.
sources.why_authoritative: Primary documentation or original research by the system authors.

sources.title: Antigravity CLI permissions
sources.finding: Permission controls and sandboxing are distinct from a tool-less advisory role. CLI versions and affordances differ.
sources.planning_impact: Never reuse skip-permissions coding profiles; probe capabilities and isolate evidence.
sources.why_authoritative: Primary documentation or original research by the system authors.

planning_constraints: Retain deterministic validators and single task ownership.
Reserve assistant budgets before dispatch; fail closed on unsupported isolation.
derived_requirements: Persist bounded cooldown and resumable pause when all allowed providers are unavailable.
Enforce a fail-closed no-write assistant boundary and keep failure classification authoritative.
risks: Native provider/OS support varies and cannot be inferred from mocked success.
validation_implications: Test routing precedence, quota resume, bounded assistant failures and wizard cancellation.
synthesis.stopping_reason: Primary evidence resolves the architecture, safety boundary, bounded cost controls and independent task boundaries.

notes: The selected primary sources justify gated assistance, not unconditional multi-agent savings.
Actual provider and Windows behavior will be reported separately from deterministic tests.
